summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script `node setup.mjs` that, at `npm install` time, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip`, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) whose contents are heavily obfuscated via a shuffled string-array decoder and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0xXXXX`, base36 names). The loader `setup.mjs` itself is similarly obfuscated, wrapping `fs`/`https` behind hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and per-function string-lookup objects. The package presents itself as a Docusaurus UI-kit documentation contrib and ships no native source that would justify pulling an alternate language runtime; the Bun runtime is fetched solely to execute an opaque, Node-unreadable payload in the installer's context. The combination of install-time alternate-runtime dropper with heavy obfuscation of both the loader and the executed bundle in a package whose stated purpose is documentation UI has no legitimate explanation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
